item.title: Sweet deal? Donald Trump claims Coca-Cola has agreed to use 'real' cane sugar in US drinks; company responds
item.description: Donald Trump announced on Truth Social that Coca-Cola has agreed to replace high-fructose corn syrup with real cane sugar in its US soft drinks, following his request. Coca-Cola acknowledged Trump's support but didn't confirm the change. The potential switch sparks debate over economic impacts and health implications, as Trump's history with Diet Coke adds intrigue.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: US-Middle East relations: Donald Trump hosts Gulf leaders at White House; Bahrain announces $17 billion in deals
item.description: Amidst renewed Middle East peace doubts and escalating violence in Syria, President Trump welcomed Bahrain's Crown Prince and Qatar's Prime Minister to the White House. Discussions centered on strengthening economic ties, highlighted by Bahrain's $17 billion investment in the US. Simultaneously, escalating conflict in Syria prompted Israeli strikes, raising regional tensions and underscoring the complexities of achieving stability.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Media frenzy’: Influencer Emilie Kiser’s husband may face felony charges after son drowned in pool; could be imprisoned for over 3 years
item.description: Brady Kiser, husband of social media influencer Emilie Kiser, might be charged. This follows the death of their three-year-old son, Trigg. Police recommended a felony child abuse charge. Trigg drowned in their backyard pool in Arizona. Brady said he was distracted. Emilie Kiser has requested privacy. She wants to prevent the release of records.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Dubai to introduce universal icons to expose levels of human and AI contribution in writing and content creation
item.description: Dubai has launched the world’s first Human–Machine Collaboration (HMC) Icons system to clarify the role of AI in content creation. Developed by the Dubai Future Foundation, it labels human and machine contributions in research, design, and production. The initiative promotes transparency, responsible AI use, and global adoption, ensuring integrity as machine involvement in creative work continues to grow.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Annabelle handler Dan Rivera's death: Pennsylvania Police share new details about hotel room where he was found
item.description: The Annabelle doll was not present in the hotel room where its handler Dan Rivera was found dead. Pennsylvania Police said they did not find anything unusual in the room, and Dan was alone in the room. Police said the doll might be inside Rivera's van in the hotel's parking lot.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: This is not about Epstein: Trump's former NSA General Flynn reacts to 'hoax' amid MAGA meltdown
item.description: Amidst the Epstein controversy, General Mike Flynn penned an open letter, disagreeing with Trump's stance on the matter. Flynn emphasized that the core issue transcends Epstein, focusing on child abuse and the need for government transparency. He urged Trump to address the concerns of his supporters, seeking to restore trust between the government and the people it serves.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Horrific and disturbing’: California couple lock 20 children in ‘hotel-like mansion', all born through surrogate mothers
item.description: In Southern California, Guojun Xuan and Silvia Zhang face charges. Authorities removed over twenty children from their Arcadia home. Most children were born via surrogacy. The couple and their nanny, Chunmei Li, face arrest warrants. Fifteen children are in protective custody. Others are with friends or family. A hospital alerted police to possible child abuse.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: New Jersey teacher accused of having a baby with a 13-year-old pleads not guilty; could face up to 40 years in prison
item.description: Laura Caron, a New Jersey teacher, pleaded not guilty to charges of sexually abusing a student over four years, starting when he was 11. She faces up to 40 years in prison if convicted on charges including aggravated sexual assault. Caron allegedly gave birth to a daughter in 2019, with the victim claiming to be the father.

item.description: The Great Dubai Summer Sale 2025 runs from July 18 to August 10, offering up to 90% off across 3,000+ stores and 800 brands. item.title: Canada: Small plane hijacked at Vancouver, flight services disrupted
item.description: Vancouver International Airport experienced a brief service disruption on Wednesday following reports of a hijacked Cessna 172. The RCMP received an alert that the aircraft, originating from Vancouver Island, was entering airspace near the airport. The incident prompted a temporary halt in flight services, with nine inbound flights diverted before the suspect was arrested upon landing.

item.title: Iceland volcanic eruption: 12th incident near capital Reykjavik in 4 years; tourists evacuated
item.description: Iceland's Sundhnukur volcano, near Reykjavik, erupted, marking the nation's 12th volcanic event since 2021. This fissure eruption prompted evacuations from the Blue Lagoon spa and Grindavik, a town previously abandoned due to volcanic threats. While lava flows southeast, Reykjavik faces no immediate danger, and air traffic remains unaffected. Experts anticipate continued regional eruptions for decades or even centuries.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Canada is a joke': Indian engineer spared from jail after trying to buy 'girlfriend experience' from 15-year-old because...
item.description: Akashkumar Narendrakumar Khant, an Indian engineer in Canada, received a conditional discharge after admitting to attempting to buy sex from a 15-year-old girl. The Ontario judge cited potential immigration consequences, such as delaying citizenship and separating him from his wife, as reasons for the lenient sentence. The judge also noted the high IQ of the accused. This decision has sparked significant public outrage.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein Hoax: Trump slams his 'past supporters' who want client list to be released, says he doesn't need them
item.description: Donald Trump has dismissed the ongoing Jeffrey Epstein controversy as a 'hoax' fabricated by Democrats, criticizing his former supporters for focusing on it. In a Truth Social post, Trump said he does not need his past supporters whom he called 'weaklings' as they have failed for the Epstein hoax and are not speaking about Trump's achievements of the last 6 months.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Epstein client list: Kevin Spacey, Stephen King baffle Internet as Republicans block release
item.description: Actor Kevin Spacey and author Stephen King grabbed the Internet's attention with their weird takes on the Epstein Files. Kevin Spacey, believed to be one of the celebrities associated with Epstein, called for the release of the files, 'all of them'; while Stephen King said Epstein Files are as real as Santa Claus
